problem_en: Two particles A and B are projected simultaneously from the same point on a horizontal ground. Particle A is projected with a velocity of 50 m/s at an angle of 37 degrees to the horizontal, and particle B is projected with a velocity of 50 m/s at 53 degrees. Find the separation between them at t = 2 seconds. (Use g = 10 m/s^2, sin 37 = 0.6, cos 37 = 0.8)
problem_hi: दो कण A और B एक क्षैतिज जमीन पर एक ही बिंदु से एक साथ प्रक्षेपित किए जाते हैं। कण A को क्षैतिज से 37 डिग्री के कोण पर 50 m/s के वेग से और कण B को 53 डिग्री पर 50 m/s के वेग से प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। t = 2 सेकंड पर उनके बीच की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए। (g = 10 m/s^2, sin 37 = 0.6, cos 37 = 0.8 का उपयोग करें)
problem_hg_030: Two particles A and B ground ke same point se simultaneously project kiye jate hain. Particle A ko 50 m/s velocity aur 37 degrees angle par project kiya, aur B ko 50 m/s velocity aur 53 degrees angle par. t = 2 seconds par unke beech ka separation find karein.
problem_hg_065: A aur B ko same ground point se project kiya gaya. A ki velocity 50 m/s angle 37 degree hai. B ki speed bhi same hai par angle 53 degree. Par projectile B ko 'pehle' launch kiya gaya aur A ko 'phir' theek 1 second baad. t = 2 seconds after A's launch, dono ke beech ki separation kitni hogi?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Calculate coordinates of A at t=2: xA = 50cos(37)2 = 80m, yA = 50sin(37)2 - 0.5102^2 = 60-20 = 40m.
Step 2: Calculate time for B (since it was launched 1s earlier, tB = 3s): xB = 50cos(53)3 = 500.63 = 90m.
Step 4: Distance = sqrt((90-80)^2 + (75-40)^2) = sqrt(10^2 + 35^2) = sqrt(100 + 1225) = sqrt(1325) ≈ 36.4... Wait, re-calculating for the HG_065 specific time offset.
Step 5: Separation = sqrt(1325) = 36.4 meters.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'Pehle...phir' ordering trap combined with the '1 second baad' timing. Most LLMs will either ignore the 1s delay or apply it to the wrong particle, failing to realize particle B has been in the air for 3 seconds when A has been up for 2.
why_hard: Requires handling non-simultaneous projection in relative motion, which shifts the origin of time for each kinematic equation.

problem_en: A stone is thrown at 20 m/s at an angle of 60 degrees. After 1 second, a second stone is thrown from the same spot at 20 m/s at 30 degrees. Find the relative velocity of the second stone with respect to the first at the moment of the second launch.
problem_hi: एक पत्थर को 60 डिग्री के कोण पर 20 m/s की गति से फेंका जाता है। 1 सेकंड बाद, दूसरा पत्थर उसी स्थान से 30 डिग्री पर 20 m/s की गति से फेंका जाता है। दूसरे प्रक्षेपण के क्षण में पहले के सापेक्ष दूसरे पत्थर का सापेक्ष वेग ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Ek stone 20 m/s ki speed se 60 degrees angle par throw kiya jata hai. 1 second baad, second stone same spot se 20 m/s at 30 degrees par throw hota hai. Relative velocity of second stone with respect to first find karein at the moment of second launch.
problem_hg_065: Ek pathar 20 m/s at 60 degree throw kiya. 1 second baad second pathar 30 degree angle par project kiya. Jab second pathar throw hua, tab first wale ki speed 'zyada' thi ya kam? Actually, second stone ki relative velocity first stone ke respect mein calculate karein accurately.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Velocity of first stone at t=1s: v1x = 20cos(60) = 10, v1y = 20sin(60) - 10(1) = 17.32 - 10 = 7.32. Vector v1 = 10i + 7.32j.
Step 2: Velocity of second stone at launch: v2x = 20cos(30) = 17.32, v2y = 20sin(30) = 10. Vector v2 = 17.32i + 10j.
Step 3: Relative velocity v21 = v2 - v1 = (17.32-10)i + (10-7.32)j = 7.32i + 2.68j.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'Zyada' trap is used as a distractor to make the LLM focus on comparing speeds rather than calculating the relative velocity vector, potentially leading to a scalar subtraction error.
why_hard: LLMs often struggle with vector subtraction in relative motion when the time-dependent vertical component is involved.

problem_en: Two particles are projected from the same point with velocities v1 = 10 m/s and v2 = 20 m/s at angles 30 and 60 degrees. Find the time when their relative vertical displacement is zero again after launch.
problem_hi: दो कणों को एक ही बिंदु से v1 = 10 m/s और v2 = 20 m/s के वेग से 30 और 60 डिग्री के कोण पर प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। वह समय ज्ञात कीजिए जब प्रक्षेपण के बाद उनका सापेक्ष ऊर्ध्वाधर विस्थापन फिर से शून्य हो जाए।
problem_hg_030: Two particles same point se project hote hain with velocities 10 m/s and 20 m/s at 30 and 60 degrees. Woh time find karein jab unka relative vertical displacement zero ho jaye launch ke baad.
problem_hg_065: Particle A (10 m/s, 30 deg) aur B (20 m/s, 60 deg) project kiye gaye. Unki height same kab hogi? Dhyaan rahe ki particle B ka velocity '3 lakh 75 hazaar' mm/s nahi balki standard units mein hai. Relative vertical displacement zero hone ka time batayein.
solution_steps_en: Step 2: Relative vertical displacement dy = y2 - y1 = (20 sin 60 - 10 sin 30)t.
Step 3: Set dy = 0. This happens when (20 * 0.866 - 10 * 0.5)t = 0.

Step 4: This implies either t=0 or the relative vertical velocity is zero. However, in standard projectile motion with same g, the t^2 terms cancel. dy = (17.32 - 5)t = 12.32t. This only equals zero at t=0 unless they hit the ground.

Step 5: If the question implies when they are at the same height, and they are projectiles, it happens at t = 0 or when they hit ground. Let's find ground time. t_ground_1 = 2100.5/10 = 1s. t_ground_2 = 2200.866/10 = 3.46s. At t=1s, particle 1 is at y=0, particle 2 is at y=12.32. They are only at same height at t=0.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The '3 lakh 75 hazaar' mm/s is a distractor to force the LLM into unnecessary unit conversions or to doubt the provided standard units.
why_hard: The math leads to a trivial answer (t=0) but the distractor unit makes the LLM look for a more complex 'collision' or 'equal height' intersection that may not exist in flight.

problem_en: Two particles A and B are projected from points (0,0) and (10,0) with velocities 20 m/s at 60 deg and 20 m/s at 120 deg. Find the minimum distance between them during flight.
problem_hi: दो कण A और B बिंदुओं (0,0) और (10,0) से 60 डिग्री पर 20 m/s और 120 डिग्री पर 20 m/s के वेग से प्रक्षेपित किए जाते हैं। उड़ान के दौरान उनके बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Particles A and B (0,0) aur (10,0) se project kiye jate hain with speeds 20 m/s at angles 60 and 120 degrees. Flight ke duration mein unke beech ka minimum distance find karein.
problem_hg_065: A (0,0) se launch hua 20 m/s, 60 deg par. B (10,0) se 120 deg par launch hua. B ki speed A se 'zyada' nahi, bilkul barabar hai. 'Baaki' parameters ignore karke unke beech ka closest approach distance calculate karein.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Relative velocity v_BA = v_B - v_A. v_Ax = 20 cos 60 = 10, v_Ay = 20 sin 60 = 17.32. v_Bx = 20 cos 120 = -10, v_By = 20 sin 120 = 17.32.
Step 3: Relative vertical velocity is zero, relative horizontal velocity is 20 m/s towards each other.

Step 4: Since they are at the same height initially and have zero relative vertical velocity, they will collide if their paths intersect. They are moving directly towards each other horizontally. Minimum distance is 0.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'Baaki' (remaining) and 'Zyada' (more) traps. 'Baaki parameters ignore karke' suggests there are missing variables, which might cause the LLM to hallucinate air resistance or mass, and 'Zyada' distorts the speed equality.
why_hard: The problem is a classic collision case, but the heavy Hinglish distorts the symmetry of the setup.

problem_en: A particle is projected from ground. After 2 seconds, its velocity vector makes 45 degrees with horizontal. After another 1 second, it is moving horizontally. Find the initial speed of projection.
problem_hi: एक कण को जमीन से प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। 2 सेकंड के बाद, इसका वेग सदिश क्षैतिज से 45 डिग्री का कोण बनाता है। और 1 सेकंड के बाद, यह क्षैतिज रूप से गति कर रहा है। प्रक्षेपण की प्रारंभिक गति ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Particle ground se project kiya. 2 seconds baad, velocity vector 45 degrees angle banata hai horizontal se. 'Pehle' 2s hue, 'phir' 1s aur baad it moves horizontally. Initial speed find karein.
problem_hg_065: Ground se ek particle throw kiya. 2 seconds baad angle 45 degree tha. 'Pehle' 2 second ke baad 'aur' 1 second beeta tab wo peak par pahucha (horizontal motion). Initial speed calculate karo, g = 10.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Horizontal motion at peak means vy = 0 at t = 2 + 1 = 3 seconds.
Step 2: vy = u sin θ - gt => 0 = u sin θ - 10(3) => u sin θ = 30.
Step 3: At t = 2s, angle is 45 deg, so vy = vx. vy(2) = u sin θ - 10(2) = 30 - 20 = 10. Thus vx = 10.

Step 4: u cos θ = 10. Initial speed u = sqrt((u sin θ)^2 + (u cos θ)^2) = sqrt(30^2 + 10^2) = sqrt(1000) = 10sqrt(10) ≈ 31.62. (Wait, sqrt(1000) is 31.62, let me re-check angle logic). 30^2 + 10^2 = 900+100=1000. Correct.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'Aur' ambiguity. In '2 second ke baad aur 1 second beeta', 'aur' means 'additional' (t=3), but a model might interpret it as 'at t=1' if it ignores the '2 second ke baad' context.
why_hard: Requires linking two different time-stamped velocity states to solve for the initial components.

problem_en: Two projectiles are launched from the same point at the same speed of 40 m/s. The first is at 30 degrees and the second at 60 degrees. Find the relative speed of the second with respect to the first at t = 1s. (g = 10)
problem_hi: दो प्रक्षेप्य एक ही बिंदु से 40 m/s की समान गति से प्रक्षेपित किए जाते हैं। पहला 30 डिग्री पर और दूसरा 60 डिग्री पर। t = 1s पर पहले के सापेक्ष दूसरे की सापेक्ष गति ज्ञात कीजिए। (g = 10)
problem_hg_030: Two projectiles same speed 40 m/s se launch kiye. First at 30 deg, second at 60 deg. t = 1s par second ki relative speed with respect to first calculate karein.
problem_hg_065: Dono projectiles 40 m/s par launch hue. Ek ka angle 30 aur dusre ka 60. Flight ke 'baaki' seconds se matlab nahi, 'sirf' t = 1s par unka relative speed batayein. Gravity 'band kar di gayi' (constant acceleration) effect ke saath.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Since both have the same acceleration g downwards, their relative acceleration is zero.
Step 2: Relative velocity remains constant throughout the flight (until one hits ground).
Step 3: v_rel = v2 - v1. v1 = 40(cos 30 i + sin 30 j) = 20√3 i + 20 j. v2 = 40(cos 60 i + sin 60 j) = 20 i + 20√3 j.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'Sirf' and 'Band kar di gayi' traps. 'Band kar di gayi' (closed/stopped) usually refers to an action, but here it's used to describe gravity being 'locked in' or 'active', which could mislead an LLM to think g=0.
why_hard: Relative velocity between two projectiles is constant, but the linguistic phrasing of 'gravity band kar di gayi' is a major red herring.

problem_en: A bomb is dropped from a plane flying horizontally at 100 m/s at an altitude of 2000 m. At the same instant, a tank on the ground starts from rest with acceleration 2 m/s^2 towards the plane. Find the initial distance between tank and plane for a hit.
problem_hi: 2000 m की ऊंचाई पर 100 m/s की गति से क्षैतिज रूप से उड़ रहे एक विमान से एक बम गिराया जाता है। उसी क्षण, जमीन पर एक टैंक विमान की ओर 2 m/s^2 के त्वरण के साथ विरामावस्था से चलना शुरू करता है। बम गिरने के लिए टैंक और विमान के बीच की प्रारंभिक दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: 100 m/s horizontally fly kar rahe plane se 2000 m altitude par bomb drop hota hai. Same instant par tank rest se start hoke 2 m/s^2 acceleration se plane ki taraf badhta hai. Initial distance find karein hit ke liye.
problem_hg_065: Plane 100 m/s se fly kar raha hai, height 2000 m hai. Bomb drop hua. 'Pehle' tank ruka hua tha, 'phir' achanak 2 m/s^2 se accelerate kiya plane ki taraf. 'Withdraw kar liya' gaya tank ka initial velocity zero se. Hit ke liye total horizontal gap kitna tha?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Time of fall for bomb: t = sqrt(2h/g) = sqrt(22000/10) = sqrt(400) = 20 seconds.
Step 2: Horizontal distance covered by bomb: xb = vb * t = 100 * 20 = 2000 m.
Step 3: Distance covered by tank: xt = 0.5 * a * t^2 = 0.5 * 2 * 20^2 = 400 m.
Step 4: For a hit, the bomb and tank must meet. Since they move towards each other, the initial separation D = xb + xt = 2000 + 400 = 2400 m.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'Withdraw kar liya' trap. In banking, it means take out. Here, 'withdraw kar liya gaya tank ka initial velocity zero se' is a convoluted way to say the initial velocity was non-zero or changed from zero, designed to confuse the LLM on the value of u_tank.
why_hard: Combines constant velocity projectile motion with constant acceleration linear motion in a relative framework.

problem_en: Two particles A and B are projected from points at the same level 100m apart. A is projected at 45 degrees with 20√2 m/s and B is projected towards A at 37 degrees with 25 m/s. Find the minimum separation between them.
problem_hi: दो कण A और B एक ही स्तर पर 100 मीटर की दूरी पर स्थित बिंदुओं से प्रक्षेपित किए जाते हैं। A को 45 डिग्री पर 20√2 m/s के साथ और B को A की ओर 37 डिग्री पर 25 m/s के साथ प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। उनके बीच न्यूनतम दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Particles A and B 100m apart level se project hote hain. A 45 degrees par 20√2 m/s se aur B A ki taraf 37 degrees par 25 m/s se. Minimum separation find karein.
problem_hg_065: A (20√2 m/s, 45 deg) aur B (25 m/s, 37 deg) launch hue. A aur B ke beech 'baaki' 100m ka gap 'na' 100m se 'zyada' tha 'na' kam. Flight ke beech closest distance calculate karo. (cos 37 = 0.8)
solution_steps_en: Step 1: uAx = 20, uAy = 20. uBx = -25 cos 37 = -20, uBy = 25 sin 37 = 15.
Step 2: Relative velocity u_rel_x = 20 - (-20) = 40, u_rel_y = 20 - 15 = 5.
Step 3: Minimum distance d_min = |(x_relu_rel_y - y_relu_rel_x)| / |u_rel|. Here x_rel = 100, y_rel = 0.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: Double negation 'na...na' is used to state the distance is exactly 100m, but the complexity of the sentence might make an LLM fail to parse the constant distance value.
why_hard: Standard 'closest approach' problem requires vector logic and minimizing a distance function in relative space.

problem_en: A particle A is projected at 50 m/s and 53 degrees. At the same time, particle B is projected from a point 120m away horizontally with speed u at angle 127 degrees to hit A in the air. Find u.
problem_hi: एक कण A को 50 m/s और 53 डिग्री पर प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। उसी समय, कण B को क्षैतिज रूप से 120m दूर एक बिंदु से गति u के साथ 127 डिग्री के कोण पर प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है ताकि वह हवा में A से टकरा सके। u का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Particle A ko 50 m/s aur 53 degrees par project kiya. Same time par, particle B 120m away se speed u aur angle 127 degrees par launch kiya gaya to hit A. u find karein.
problem_hg_065: A (50 m/s, 53 deg) launch hua. B 120m door se project kiya gaya angle 127 deg (from ground positive x) par. 'Sirf' tabhi collision hoga agar vertical speeds same hon? Nahi, calculate karein u ki value for hit.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: For a collision, the relative velocity must be directed along the line joining the particles.
Step 2: y-components of velocity: uAy = 50 sin 53 = 50 * 0.8 = 40. uBy = u sin 127 = u * 0.8.
Step 3: For collision starting from same level, relative vertical velocity must be zero: 40 - 0.8u = 0 => u = 50 m/s.

Step 4: Check if they meet before hitting ground. uAx = 50 cos 53 = 30. uBx = 50 cos 127 = -30. Relative horizontal speed = 60. Time to meet = 120 / 60 = 2s. Ground time = 2 * 40 / 10 = 8s. 2s < 8s, so they hit.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'Sirf' trap combined with a leading false hypothesis ('agar vertical speeds same hon?') designed to tempt the LLM into a simplified but potentially wrong logic path.
why_hard: Collision of two projectiles requires equating both vertical and horizontal relative motion constraints.

problem_en: Two particles are projected simultaneously from the top of a tower 100m high with speeds 10 m/s each. One is projected at 30 deg above horizontal, and the other at 30 deg below. Find the separation when the first one hits the ground. (g=10)
problem_hi: 100 मीटर ऊंचे टॉवर के ऊपर से दो कण एक साथ 10 m/s की गति से प्रक्षेपित किए जाते हैं। एक को क्षैतिज से 30 डिग्री ऊपर और दूसरे को 30 डिग्री नीचे प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। जब पहला जमीन से टकराता है तो उनके बीच की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए। (g=10)
problem_hg_030: Two particles tower top (100m high) se 10 m/s speed se project kiye jate hain. Ek 30 deg above horizontal aur dusra 30 deg below. Separation find karein jab first one hits the ground.
problem_hg_065: 100m tower se do particles 10 m/s speed par throw kiye. Ek ka angle 30 deg up, dusre ka 30 deg down. 'Pehle' wala jab ground hit karega, 'phir' unke beech ka distance kitna hoga? (Note: Both projected same time).
solution_steps_en: Step 1: First one hits ground (angle -30 deg): -100 = (10 sin -30)t - 5t^2 => -100 = -5t - 5t^2 => t^2 + t - 20 = 0 => (t+5)(t-4)=0. t = 4s.
Step 2: Relative velocity vector: v_rel = v1 - v2 = (10 cos 30 i + 10 sin 30 j) - (10 cos 30 i - 10 sin 30 j) = 20 sin 30 j = 10 j.
Step 3: Relative acceleration is zero. Distance = v_rel * t = 10 * 4 = 40 m. (Wait, let me check which one hits ground first).
Step 4: The one projected downwards (-30) hits at t=4s. The other is still in flight. Relative displacement is (10 m/s upward) * 4s = 40 m.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'Pehle...phir' trap. It makes the hitting of the ground seem sequential, which might lead the LLM to calculate the state at different times rather than the separation at a single instant.
why_hard: Requires calculating time of flight for a projectile from a height and applying it to the relative motion vector.

problem_en: Two particles A and B are projected from ground with uA = 20 m/s at 30 deg and uB = 20 m/s at 60 deg. Find the height of A when their relative horizontal displacement is zero.
problem_hi: दो कणों A और B को uA = 20 m/s (30 डिग्री) और uB = 20 m/s (60 डिग्री) के साथ जमीन से प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। जब उनका सापेक्ष क्षैतिज विस्थापन शून्य हो, तो A की ऊंचाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Two particles ground se uA = 20 m/s at 30 deg aur uB = 20 m/s at 60 deg launch kiye. Height of A find karein jab unka relative horizontal displacement zero ho.
problem_hg_065: A (20, 30 deg) aur B (20, 60 deg) project kiye. Ground horizontal separation zero hai starting mein. 'Baaki' flight mein unki relative horizontal displacement zero 'sirf' t=0 par hogi? Calculate height of A when it is maximum.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Horizontal displacement xA = 20 cos 30 t, xB = 20 cos 60 t.
Step 2: Relative horizontal displacement = (20 cos 30 - 20 cos 60)t. This is zero only at t = 0 for particles starting at same x.
Step 3: The question wording in HG_065 asks for height of A when it is maximum if the condition is trivial. H_max = u^2 sin^2 θ / 2g = 20^2 * (0.5)^2 / 20 = 400 * 0.25 / 20 = 100 / 20 = 5 m.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'Baaki' and 'Sirf' traps are combined with an instruction change at the end ('Calculate height of A when it is maximum'), which contradicts the initial 'relative displacement' prompt.
why_hard: LLMs often get stuck on the first condition provided and ignore the sudden shift in the goal of the problem found at the end of the Hinglish text.

problem_en: A particle is projected at 40 m/s at 60 deg. At t = 2s, what is the relative velocity of the particle with respect to its initial velocity?
problem_hi: एक कण को 60 डिग्री पर 40 m/s की गति से प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। t = 2s पर, प्रारंभिक वेग के सापेक्ष कण का सापेक्ष वेग क्या है?
problem_hg_030: Particle 40 m/s speed aur 60 deg angle par project kiya. t = 2s par, relative velocity of particle with respect to its initial velocity find karein.
problem_hg_065: 40 m/s at 60 degree par particle throw kiya. 'Pehle' launch velocity u thi. t = 2s baad current velocity v hai. v ki relative velocity u ke respect mein kitni hogi? Gravity value '10' hi lein.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Initial velocity u = 40 cos 60 i + 40 sin 60 j = 20 i + 20√3 j.
Step 2: Velocity at t=2: vx = 20, vy = 20√3 - g(2) = 20√3 - 20.
Step 3: Relative velocity v_rel = v - u = (20-20)i + (20√3 - 20 - 20√3)j = -20j.
Step 4: Magnitude is |-20| = 20 m/s.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'Pehle' trap used to set up a vector comparison. LLMs often do scalar speed subtraction (speed at t=2 minus initial speed) instead of vector relative velocity.
why_hard: Requires vector subtraction of the same particle's velocity over time, which is conceptually simpler but often results in calculation errors in LLMs.

problem_en: Two particles A and B are projected from the same ground point. A is projected at 30 m/s and 90 deg (vertical). B is projected at 30√2 m/s and 45 deg. Find the separation at t = 1s.
problem_hi: दो कण A और B एक ही जमीन के बिंदु से प्रक्षेपित किए जाते हैं। A को 30 m/s और 90 डिग्री (ऊर्ध्वाधर) पर प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। B को 30√2 m/s और 45 डिग्री पर प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। t = 1s पर उनके बीच की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Particles A and B same point se project hue. A 30 m/s at 90 deg (vertical). B 30√2 m/s at 45 deg. t = 1s par unke beech ka separation find karein.
problem_hg_065: A (30 m/s vertical) aur B (30√2 m/s, 45 deg) project hue. '6 mahine' (actually t=1s) baad unke beech kitna gap hoga? Acceleration 'band kar di gayi' calculate mat karna, relative velocity use karo.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: uA = 30j. uB = 30√2 cos 45 i + 30√2 sin 45 j = 30i + 30j.
Step 2: Relative velocity v_rel = uB - uA = (30i + 30j) - 30j = 30i.
Step 3: Relative acceleration is 0. Displacement s_rel = v_rel * t = 30i * 1 = 30i.
Step 4: Separation = |30i| = 30m.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The '6 mahine' (6 months) is used as a temporal distractor for t=1s, and 'acceleration band kar di gayi' is a trap to see if the LLM correctly identifies that relative acceleration is zero.
why_hard: Tests the identification of constant relative velocity between projectiles using bizarre Hinglish temporal and mechanical metaphors.

problem_en: From a height of 80m, particle A is thrown horizontally at 20 m/s. Simultaneously, particle B is thrown from ground with velocity u such that it hits A at its highest point. Find u.
problem_hi: 80m की ऊंचाई से, कण A को 20 m/s की गति से क्षैतिज रूप से फेंका जाता है। उसी समय, कण B को जमीन से वेग u के साथ इस तरह फेंका जाता है कि वह A को उसके उच्चतम बिंदु पर मारे। u ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: 80m height se, particle A horizontally 20 m/s par throw kiya. Simultaneously, B ground se velocity u ke sath throw kiya to hit A at its highest point. u find karein.
problem_hg_065: Height 80m se A horizontal throw hua. 'Baaki' ground se B launch hua speed u par. B ko A ko hit karna hai tab jab A apne 'highest point' par ho. Dhyaan de: A is projected horizontally.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: A is projected horizontally, so its highest point is the launch point (80m).
Step 2: For B to hit A at A's highest point, B must reach (0, 80) at some time t.
Step 3: This is impossible to define without knowing the horizontal launch position of B. If B is launched from ground below A's start, u_y must reach 80m.

Step 4: This is a linguistic trap problem where 'highest point' for a horizontal projectile is t=0. Thus u for B would need to be infinite or the collision is at launch. In context of problems, LLMs will struggle with the logic that A's highest point is t=0.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'Highest point' trap for a horizontally projected particle. LLMs assume every projectile has a parabolic peak in the future, whereas for horizontal projection, the peak is the start.
why_hard: Tests the conceptual understanding of projectile trajectories versus the linguistic assumption of 'peaks'.

problem_en: Particle A is projected at 20 m/s at 60 deg. Particle B is projected at 20 m/s at 30 deg. Find the magnitude of relative velocity at t = 0.
problem_hi: कण A को 60 डिग्री पर 20 m/s की गति से प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। कण B को 30 डिग्री पर 20 m/s की गति से प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। t = 0 पर सापेक्ष वेग का परिमाण ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Particle A 20 m/s speed aur 60 deg par project kiya. B 20 m/s aur 30 deg par. t = 0 par relative velocity find karein.
problem_hg_065: A (20, 60 deg) aur B (20, 30 deg) launch hue. 'Pehle' launch se 'phir' flight tak 'sirf' t=0 seconds par relative velocity magnitude kya hoga? Cos 30 = 0.866.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: vA = 20 cos 60 i + 20 sin 60 j = 10i + 17.32j.
Step 2: vB = 20 cos 30 i + 20 sin 30 j = 17.32i + 10j.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: The 'Pehle...phir...sirf' sequence is a logic noise trap designed to hide a very simple calculation behind unnecessary linguistic structure.
why_hard: Standard vector subtraction that LLMs often miscalculate by performing scalar subtraction of the speeds (20 - 20 = 0).
